notes: Curated eval for the craft-pass output contract. Routing prompts stay on practitioner language; output checks require the skill's leading test, not a section list.

should_trigger.prompt: Please build role-based ramp plans that help new hires become productive faster through job-critical practice, evidence checkpoints, and manager coaching.
I need onboarding plans, 30-60-90 views, competency-based ramp plans, manager check-ins, or diagnostic onboarding checkpoints for sales or customer-facing teams.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable onboarding program and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please create role-based readiness certifications with evidence requirements, defensible pass/fail standards, behaviorally anchored scoring, and assessor calibration.
Please build developmental sales role-play scenarios with facilitator-only briefs, behaviorally anchored feedback, and run protocols.
Please audit a sample of discovery calls with one consistent rubric and turn portfolio-level patterns into manager-ready coaching priorities.
Build a customer onboarding-to-value playbook with implementation milestones, adoption signals, and first-value events.

output_structure_checks.name: onboarding-program-builder-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: Defines ready as inspectable weekly proof of behavior, not a 30-60-90 calendar or course completion.

output_structure_checks.name: onboarding-program-builder-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: Maps job tasks to practice, live-work evidence, and a weekly manager check that names this week's observable proof.

output_structure_checks.name: onboarding-program-builder-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: Includes experience-level variants and a capacity ledger with a fits, reduce, sequence, or blocked decision.

output_structure_checks.name: onboarding-program-builder-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: Keeps the diagnostic tracker separate from any formal pass/fail and includes a certification handoff only when a gate is in scope.

output_structure_checks.name: onboarding-program-builder-output-05
output_structure_checks.description: Treats course completion and calendar dates as insufficient proof of readiness, and does not write a customer time-to-value journey.
